Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Trip TRP-02846. The driver's route was longer than the platform's optimal route by 0.85 km, and under POL-RD-01 that establishes a deviation. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02846): 4.05 km driven between the recorded trip start and the recorded completion. The booking-time optimal route is 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02846, routing-engine-v3.2). The excess of 0.85 km is 26.56% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 gates pass — greater than 0.80 km and greater than 20%. The rounded 4.0 km convenience copy on the trip record is not used for the threshold test, as POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

Trip TRP-02846. The driver's route was longer than the platform's optimal route by 0.85 km, and under POL-RD-01 that establishes a deviation. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02846): 4.05 km driven between the recorded trip start and the recorded completion. The booking-time optimal route is 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02846, routing-engine-v3.2). The excess of 0.85 km is 26.56% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 gates pass — greater than 0.80 km and greater than 20%. The rounded 4.0 km convenience copy on the trip record is not used for the threshold test, as POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure. The driver's argument that the 0.05 km margin over the 0.80 km gate is finer than the trace's own fix spacing is rejected. POL-RD-01 states a strict numeric gate and supplies no tolerance keyed to sampling resolution, and the trace is not impaired: 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of the POL-RD-07 limbs (a)–(c) fires. An excess of 0.85 km is greater than 0.80 km as the clause requires. The deviation is not MATERIAL (26.56% is below 50% and 0.85 km is below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged by materiality. Even if the driver profile is consulted, the pattern test fails on the fields the clause names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 398. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (value 1) is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used against the driver. There is accordingly no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. POL-RD-12 also does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the baseline stays the booked 3.2 km. Nothing excuses any part of the excess.
